title: Brownian First-Visit Cell Lengths on the Circle
statement: Choose starting points $p_1,\ldots,p_k$ on the unit circle and run independent Brownian motions from them. If $B_i$ is the set of points first visited by the motion started at $p_i$, determine the joint distribution of $(|B_1|,\ldots,|B_k|)$.
